reason: As a concept, a pre-registered E10 v2 rule is sound and can be built in time. Two facts hold: the K2 patches apply once per anchor to x138-family notebooks (R11S-1, PC11-04), and HF v3 passes the static e10_port_gate. R4 already makes a successor whose public score is 0 or +0.001 above #37 an F2 candidate. So acting at a displayed 0.954 by replacing the twin (#38) is consistent with R4, and #37 stays in every pair. The value is real but small and rests on priors: P(trigger) ~10-15%, expected dP(bronze) ~+0.03-0.05. The draft text should NOT go to the user as written. (1) 'Last submit 29 Sep 10:00' and 'first seen by 29 Sep 06:00' break R8, which allows only an emergency repeat after 02:00 with 10:00 as the hard edge. They also do not fit the schedule: SI L_hi 9.5 h plus the poll gives a read at ~19:40Z, 20 min before the 20:00Z tick end, with a user re-tick still needed. (2) tools/runtime_ledger.py has no exp67 rule, so the family is 'unknown' and R5(a) cannot be read. (3) The trigger's 'e10_port_gate returns PASS' is ambiguous: a static run already prints PASS while notebook-bytes, dummy-log, csv and node-counts are SKIP. (4) Four clauses are missing: 'first seen after the OK timestamp'; 'successor touches the division stages -> no SI' (the insertion's evidence exists only on x138's division logic); a precedence line (PC11-05); and the amendments to 'S12/S13 empty' and R8's 28 Sep 12:00 consolidation cutoff. (5) The draft does not say that SI has no lab gate on the successor. Its gate is transfer by construction, which R8's 'honest lab gate' requires to be stated. (6) The recipe conflicts with plan-check PC11-07: K2 here (lowrefine ON), K1 there. (7) Row R1 prefers SI on any public tie. R11S-2's own MC shows an early PORT is better for bronze (0.84-0.93 vs 0.80-0.87). {SI, #37} also drops the no-insertion hedge (C2 P(<0) 0.10-0.15). The OK text must state this bronze-vs-silver trade. (8) The HF v3 proxy is x138 with comments stripped, so it tests only the builder's mechanics.
fix: Before asking for the OK, edit the V2 text. (a) Time limits back to P7/R8: last trigger check 29 Sep 00:00Z (add checks at 28 Sep 21:00Z and every 3 h from 27 Sep 12:00Z), last PORT/SI submit 29 Sep 02:00Z, and SI acted on only if all its dummies are terminal by 01:45Z. (b) Add (r"exp67[a-z]*", "safetail") to tools/runtime_ledger.py EXP_RULES with a test; exp63 stays for verbatim ports only. (c) Trigger = static e10_port_gate PASS. Before any submit, require a full gate run (--pulled --port --dummy --author) with 0 FAIL and 0 SKIP. (d) Add these lines: 'applies only to a successor first seen (e10_watch snapshot ref+version) after the OK timestamp'; 'if the successor's diff vs exp56 touches add_safe_divisions_postlink, the division-geometry or fork filters or the DeepCenter safe-division thresholds -> no SI, PORT only'; 'for public successors: E10 v2 > E10 PORT RULE > f2 > R4'; 'S12/S13 empty unless E10/E10 v2; E10 v2 submits are exempt from the 28 Sep 12:00 consolidation cutoff, not from 29 Sep 02:00'. (e) State the SI gate as 'transfer by construction (code-delta identity + dummies G1-G7 + public read), not measured on S'. (f) Settle K1 vs K2 with the plan check. My preference is K1 (divinsert + safetail, LOWREFINE_ENABLE=0; identity test exp56-as-S -> exp58t a77bcd6b): lowrefine's private prior is ~0, and it adds 0.14 h and 4 threshold anchors a successor may have moved. (g) Offer the user the SI-vs-PORT preference as an explicit choice: 'bronze-first: {PORT, #37} when PORT went in within ~6 h of first sight, else SI' or 'silver-first: SI on tie' (the draft's R1). Keep never-drop-#37 and never-{SI, PORT}. (h) Label the HF v3 proxy as a mechanics-only check. If the code, tests, byte-identical finals rebuild (1f1ddb6d/55038fd6/a77bcd6b) and proxy dummies are not committed by 27 Sep 12:00Z, fall back to PORT-only at >= 0.954.
realistic_gain: Zero in the ~85-90% of worlds with no qualifying successor, apart from ~2-3 h of tooling and 3 proxy GPU dummies. Given a trigger, the model gives a ~+0.25-0.45 P(bronze) swing against doing nothing. These numbers are priors, not measurements. Unconditional expected dP(bronze) is ~+0.03-0.05; the silver gain from SI over PORT is ~+0.01. The finals stay #37 + #38 unless the rule fires.
